tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, and not falling like 時 si4.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (compare: 試 si3 is mid-level; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits lower and stays flat)

tasks.prompt: One timed 60-sec intro for tomorrow's smart-mobility interview. Order: Present → Past → Future. In the Past proof, use Point → Reason → Example. Record it, listen back once, then check 📜. (You can swap in STAR #1 or #2 if the intro already feels solid.)
tasks.script:
Present: I use GIS and spatial analysis to understand how people move through the city.
Past: Most recently, I worked as a research assistant on an ageing-friendly city project.
Point: I needed a clear picture of how older residents moved around public housing estates.
Reason: The street-view data we first had was too patchy at community level, so any movement analysis would have been guesswork.
Example: I proposed a government spatial-data API, reached about 98 percent coverage, and then used the activity pattern — mainly in spring and winter, within two to three MTR stations — to recommend a narrower distance buffer.
Future: Going forward, I want to apply the same approach to smart-mobility questions: start from observed movement, then tighten the model.

questions.q: Tone number for 事 in 有咩事呀？
questions.explain: 事 si6, low flat. Not 試 si3 (mid) and not 時 si4 (falling).
现在 → 过去 → 未来. Do not shuffle.

questions.q: Fill in: Older residents were mainly active ___ spring and winter.
questions.explain: in spring and winter — no the.

options: The team narrowed the distance buffer for the regression analysis.
We opened a new MTR station.
questions.explain: As a result, the team narrowed the distance buffer so the model matched where people actually go.

questions.q: About what coverage did the street-view dataset reach? (number only is fine)
questions.explain: About 98% coverage, so movement analysis did not have to guess from missing streets.

questions.q: When you explain something, the order is…

options: I start from a finished model, then look for movement later.
In mobility work, I start from observed movement, then I tighten the spatial model to match it.
I only report the coverage number and stop.
questions.explain: 先观察出行，再把空间模型收紧去贴合它。
